messages.subject: CPD: 'Warranty & indemnity insurance in M&A' - 14 Jan, lunchtime
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

A reminder that the corporate team CPD session on W&I insurance in M&A transactions is on Tuesday 14 January, 12.30-1.30pm in the 6th floor training room (lunch provided). It counts for 1 hour of CPD. Let me know if you would like me to reserve you a place.

Donna
